items.title: Frank Christian Interview, 1965-09-06
items.q: The interviewee describes Jimmy Durante's behavior in a general sense ('Jimmy had a number for everybody who used to come in the place... Everyone. And they all knew it') without indicating a personal relationship or direct interaction with Jimmy.

ctx.x: Can you tell us about Jimmy Durante? Was he a good pianist? Or how did he play?
Was he a comedian then too? He was pretty good.
